propositions: transition_close.py at 803 LOC exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap, causing the module-size CI gate to fail and block all Gerrit changes from reaching Verified +1

The completion-verification precheck cluster (_completion_precheck, _referencing_commit_exists, _is_live_ticket, _has_live_replacement_link, _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES) forms a self-contained call-graph seam that can be extracted into a new sibling module without logic changes

After the split, transition_close.py must import _completion_precheck as a module-level binding so dynamic lookup in close_ticket and monkeypatches in existing tests remain functional without modification

All existing close/completion integration and unit tests must pass unchanged (only test_transition_close.py's import path for _referencing_commit_exists is repointed) to guarantee behavior preservation
